row.notes: Removes a 16-byte {fn, ctx} handler from the vector at *(owner+0xd8) (+8 begin, +0x10 end): finds the entry with both qwords equal, shifts the tail down and shrinks end by 0x10. Returns 0, or 2 (not found, also recorded in the errno trace ring). Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): partial, better name Game_Vec16_RemoveByKey_ListD8: Linear-scans the vector of 16-byte entries at (param_1+0xd8)+8..+0x10 for an entry equal to the 16-byte key *param_2, shifts the tail down and shrinks by 16, returns 0 or errno 2; nothing shows the entries are message handlers.
